title: ISO 4405:2022 — Hydraulic fluid power — Fluid contamination — Determination of particulate contamination by the gravimetric method
locator: Abstract: gravimetric method for determining contamination level of fluids used in hydraulic fluid power systems; scope describes mineral-oil pressure fluids with additives in hydrostatic drives.
notes: Method standard, not a fluid cleanliness target. Do not assume applicability to all coolant emulsions or non-mineral fluids without checking the complete scope and method conditions.
